notes.title: HUGE Update v2022.004.000 & Spring Sale!
notes.content:
Let's jump right into spring this year with the long-anticipated 001 Game Creator update you have all been waiting for, as well as a discount on the software and DLC's! The change log is absolutely massive with over 50 changes fresh off the press, with a wide assortment of new features, enhancements and bug fixes. So let's dive right in and break down some of the best parts of this update!

[h2]New 3D Lighting Demo & Template Updates[/h2]
A spectacular new advanced lighting demo has been added, so users can check out how to set up some awesome lighting effects used in a 3D scene. Some of the setups include moving lights, light switches, explosions and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/acec1f565365cb8ad0cc17f7bbbb84e12ee4bcae.png[/img]

We've also been upgrading the performances within our existing template demos too: adding a default cursor to the Visual Novel, updated music used in the Platformer; and resolving the character collision clipping in the ground and improving the bed model in the 3D Action RPG. Issues with the crouching and spawning mechanics in the 3D FPS Survival Horror have also been resolved, and we also improved the guidance and the mechanics of the puzzle.  For the 3D adventure, we fixed the issue that prevented progression.

[h2]Moved Example and Demo Folders [/h2]
We've recently received reports that the example and demo projects weren't working, and upon investigating further, we realized that the issues were tied to having multiple user accounts. To resolve this, we moved the location of the example and demo projects from "My Documents" to "Program Files". It is safe to delete both the "Demos" and "Examples" folders, as they will no longer be used by the engine. To access the latest demos and examples, you can create a new game and select it from the template selection window.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/2d54ba816587c186ccba73a74238b13de70194a9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/a6a091e1c585685428947d52e5cbe6acc3845c63.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/650761a604014e8fc0cb5da6f26f26762a58a539.png[/img]

[h2]Loading & Restarting Issues Resolved[/h2]
Various issues have been reported with how saving and loading works, and we've tackled 'em all! Some of these issues include controls being properly stored within save game data, or restarting the game causing controls to reset. We have also included some other changes such as having global variables and system scripts properly update when loading a full saved game.

[h2]Improved Performance & Debugger Fixes[/h2]
Compared to previous versions, you can expect various performance improvements in both the editor as well as in your existing games! Inside the "Game Settings" you can find a new section dedicated to various existing and new performance options. You can now limit how often your actors and fields update globally with the new "Process state triggers every frame." option, which will dramatically improve performance in most projects. We've also fixed the "Slowest Trigger Scripts" feature of the performance debugger, as well added a new "Slowest Interface" option to help figure out exactly what's making your game run slow!

[h2]New Use Values & Team Fixes[/h2]
We have added some new use values in preparation of a new upcoming feature that you can leverage in your projects! You can now easily access the interface co-ordinates for each of the edges of the screen, allowing you to scale and position interface elements manually in your scripts. We also added a use value to determine the alliance/relationship between multiple teams, expanding your possibilities for customizable actor AI! We have also fixed some edge-cases with how teams behaved, such as issues when a team is negative towards itself.

[h2]Fixed Render Issues, Crashes, Glitches & More[/h2]
This release comes bundled with a tremendous amount of fixes, some minor such as animation stutters, some major such as game-breaking crashes. A highlight of some of these fixes include: Animations stuttering when an actor follows another actor; Crashes and memory issues related to unloading maps; Crashes when using colored text; Games not closing properly and relaunching under certain circumstances; Ensured many actor properties are carried over when using "Change Actor Template"; and SO much more! Please note that In-App Purchases will become available outside of the beta version once the feature is compatible with all platforms.

As always, we appreciate the continued support and feedback that we receive from our community. You can view the full list of changes for the newest update and the previous ones from the changelog below:
https://001gamecreator.com/changes/

[h2]Tutorial Updates[/h2]
Earlier this year we were happy to announce the launch of our new video tutorial series dedicated entirely to Resources! In the first video you will get an overview of how the sprite editor works, as well as how to create a new sprite. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/34b63fe32929e1de356a8cd227fcaa6c20038e98.png[/img]

If you haven't checked it out already, we also recommend you take a look at the 6 part "Basics" series which completed last year. For links to all of our latest video tutorials check out the page below:
https://001gamecreator.com/video-guides/

Alongside our video tutorials, we have also been working on getting more text tutorials out as well! Since the last update we released a tutorial showing you how to import tile-sets that aren't locked to the 32x32 tile grid! You can easily utilize tiles that are 16x16, 64x64, etc. To learn how to do this check out our Game Recipes page below:
https://001gamecreator.com/game-recipes/

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/7e9e5ea7c0211e36acfca3b8f57aa652c2cd857e.png[/img]

If you want to get first-access to our Game Recipes, Video Tutorials, Software Betas and more, please consider supporting us on Patreon. All of these tutorials and updates are possible thanks to each and every one of our supporters who help us out:
https://www.patreon.com/softweir

[h2]Spring Sale[/h2]
Let's hop into spring with a discount of 001 Game Creator at 60% off and all of your favorite DLC's for up to 30% off until April 19th! You can create various genres of games in no time at all, from a first-person shooter to even your own MMORPG. Jump-start your dream project this spring!

[h2]Previous Updates[/h2]
In case you've been out of the loop, some of the notable features and fixes from our last update include: Added support for Android App Bundles to be compliant with new android publishing rules; Map transitions are no longer glitched with irregularly shaped actors; Fields incorrectly resetting their "Time" value when resized; Animated "Window" fields not properly animating and more.

notes.title: End of Year Review
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/a3bacf3a7e39daf835f0c45c674651769f77fc1b.png[/img]

2021 has been an uplifting year as we have taken several huge steps for 001 Game Creator. We reflect on those moments of advancements, and we list them in this End-of-Year review.

In early spring, we launched a gigantic new version of 001 Game Creator! This engine update fixed several major bugs, improved map weather options and included new features.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/c3895cb10604ae34c71ccf4c5fb4a2d97ca771a5.png[/img]

The new map weather events enhanced the users' capability of creating interesting atmospheres and captivating scenes on any map! These options included changing the maximum and minimum speed, as well as the opacity, for the clouds and rain. Users also gained the ability to change the cloud/rain sprites or the wind direction through scripting. Additionally, we have greatly improved the range used for each weather slider, making it far easier to setup rain and clouds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/3365810fffc9e63a32cbe105d35fe76ccb54f0ff.png[/img]

For the first time, users can finally organize and create lists of options in custom events and network messages.

Users can also access the list of the project’s globals through the “Global Variables Collection” and “Switches Collection” use values.

We also enabled the user to be able to import GIF files through the sprite editor when adding “Image Files”.

Weeks later, another engine update was released, and it included the Render Priority Option for Actors. The "Render Priority" will support rendering of semi-transparent actors against each other properly when they partially overlap, or when handing z-fighting issues. It quite useful for projects that centralizes on one-to-one combat between actors that constantly overlap each other. 

Besides providing the Render Priority Option for Actors, this newer version fixed countless of issues - log messages that don't disappear over time in the editor, map boundary connections collision issues, party crashes, errors and memory leaks for terraformations, and inaccurate Android touches. We also did a hot fix on the Tile-set Editor on Tiles and Terraformations. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/ed23f50cb0399d3c6a52507fa8c1e4eddbe477e7.png[/img]

In the midst of the year, we have been updating and improving several webpages of the [url=https://001gamecreator.com/wiki/]Wiki Documentation [/url]as the engine continues to evolve. Now, users can read-up on tips on how to include color codes for constant boxes, beneficial details on utilizing non-32x32 tiles, as well as mouse/touch support, and so much more! Be sure to utilize the wiki anytime you need a reference of what a feature does.

To assist with specific coding scripts and tutorials, we released more [url=https://001gamecreator.com/game-recipes/ ]Game Recipes[/url] to the public. These game recipes are set up to be simple tutorials with easy-to-follow instructions as Steam guides. Be sure to check all of our game recipes to improve your games in various ways. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/fe15ec0d4df731d82a7c6d1d688e20ef035f8796.png[/img]

On YouTube, we finally concluded our on-going [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLgohPz-X6Ywh7gzs0Js7GIc-j807NjL44]video tutorial series[/url] that covered the "Basics" of using 001 Game Creator. Watch this six-episode series at any time from the very beginning to learn everything you need to get started with 001! Right now, Patreon members have first access to episode 1 of our next series dedicated to Resources. Be sure to keep an eye out for it's release!

For users who've needed extensive assistance with their specific code or scripts, the team has helped them on many occasions through the [url=https://001gamecreator.com/training-and-scripting-service/]online scripting service[/url]. It's an optional tutoring session when the user can have a one-on-one session with one of our team members for an hour or more. It's a more personal setting than the Discord support thread, but we'll continue to answer any questions on any of our social platforms. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/f16b67c1ed22ba0b1b9e757619d73e692c712df7.png[/img]

Toward the end of the year, our biggest achievement is being able to finally release a Beta version of the In-App Purchase (IAP) feature. This highly requested feature enables the engine users to use this option in Steam (as DLCs) and Android in order to monetize their games. Right now, our [url=https://www.patreon.com/softweir]Patreon members [/url]have first access to this feature in the newest Beta version, and it will be released to the public when it is well-developed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/7e9e5ea7c0211e36acfca3b8f57aa652c2cd857e.png[/img]

Besides getting a sneak peak at the In-App Purchase feature, patrons also get privileges of having first-access to the video tutorials, game recipes, and the newest Beta version of 001 Game Creator. The newest Beta version significantly fixes several bugs and performance issues, which resolves memory leaks, weapons targeting themselves, restarting a game from resetting controls, etc., and it will later-on be released to the public.

To announce this glorious moment and other exciting announcements, we took this opportunity to release our newly-formatted [url=https://001gamecreator.com/newsletter/]001 E-Newsletter.[/url] It has been setup for followers to get the latest details on the updates, sales, and promotional events about 001 Game Creator and other projects related to the main engine or its DLCs. Be sure to join it to keep in the loop of all exciting SoftWeir products!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/d6b87b59e4852d59d423dd9f16740c75a312a67b.png[/img]

For the first time in a long time, the team hosted a cash challenge on our first [url=https://youtu.be/qpzd1RQJkOQ]Spooktacular Game Jam[/url] in October. When we received a handful of entries, we selected a few projects to play during our first live streaming event and announced the winners on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/001gamecreator]Twitch[/url]. You can download and play all of our fantastic entries by clicking [url=https://001gamecreator.com/games/halloween-2021/]here[/url]!

Although we love delivering new requests, features and downloadable contents throughout the year, we still have to keep our balance of time and workflow, while resolving any current issues and instabilities reported to us by the community and team members. As a result of our continued growth and support, we were able to work on and release new projects while still providing features and fixes to 001 this year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/5c87bba12a4f4bc1ed2709fd60efe083dcf437d5.png[/img]

One of those pipeline projects that has been released to the public is the Easy Game Creator! The [url=https://easy-game-creator.com/anniversary/]Easy Game Creator[/url] is a one-of-a-kind software that allows the user to create a personalized video game experience in minutes. Already, tons of people are using this perfect tool to great a memorable and fun gift for a loved one!
(Pssst, for those who are in the loop, this isn't the "Super Secret" project we've been working on for years. Be sure to follow us on Patreon and our other forms of social media for more details on that project later!)

Besides working on this project (as well as others), we still aim to deliver new engine versions to the public as soon as possible, so expect new surprises in the pipeline at the beginning of next year! 

All of this and more would not have been possible if it weren't for the amazing support that we've been receiving from our Patreon members and community! We enjoy moments when members can help other folks in the Discord thread and appreciate reading encouraging comments and feedback! All of your feedback helped us to improve our products and service throughout the years. As such, thank you! We hope the community and Patreon members grow to the point when we can release webinars in the future!

On behalf of everyone on the whole team, we also wish you a Happy New Year! Thank you for your dedicated support, and we hope to see more amazing games from you in 2022!

Stay cool because we just released the third new update this year for 001 Game Creator, with new changes and performance improvements!  We hope that you enjoy this new version (2021.008.000) and checkout the highlighted features that are mentioned below before this hot summer ends.

[h2]Irregular Shaped Actors (like Vehicles, Airplanes, etc.)[/h2]
Folks who are using irregular shaped actors (like vehicles, airplanes, etc.) in their projects will enjoy this new update! We've fixed the edge case issues with irregular shaped actors moving between map boundary connections, and we've even fixed the AI pathfinding issues too. 

[h2]Improper Valid Saves & d8vb.dll Isn't Registered[/h2]
We have also fixed sprite and item templates not saving properly as well as fixing some incorrect template associations for body sprites in the MMORPG template. Besides making template changes, we also clarified for users that a restart must be performed if dx8vb.dll isn't registered properly for built games.

[h2]Submerged Actors Using Equipment[/h2]
What if an equipment cannot be properly used underwater? Some users noticed that they could not use any equipment when their actors are submerged underwater. We've resolved this issue, but users can create scripts if they don't want submerged actors to use any equipment.

We have been releasing new updates this year, and there were some cool stuff, so make sure you have the newest version! You should see 2021.008.000. Mobile users will no longer deal with the inaccurate Android touches from certain manufacturers (OnePlus, LG and Redmi). notes.title: New 001 Game Creator Version 2021.004.000 + 001/DLC Sale + Amazon Book Sale
notes.content:
We're thrilled to release the second new update this year for 001 Game Creator, with new changes and performance improvements! We hope that you enjoy this major update and checkout the things that are mentioned below.  

[h2][b]Render Priority Option for Actors[/b][/h2]

If you have a project that focuses on one-on-one combat between actors or actors that constantly overlap with each other, then you'll love this new feature. We have added the "Render Priority" option to actors.  The "Render Priority" will support rendering of semi-transparent actors against each other properly when they partially overlap, or when handing z-fighting issues.

[h2][b]Hot Fix for the Tile-Set Editor on Tiles and Terraformations[/b]
[/h2]
This version also fixes the memory leaks and loss of graphics in the tile-set editor when copying, pasting and editing tiles and terraformations. Therefore, you should be able to preview everything without experiencing any graphical issues throughout the editing process. 

[h2][b]Inaccurate Android Touches & Text to Number Conversions (on Android, iOS & HTML5)[/b][/h2]

Additionally, mobile users will notice that this version fixes the inaccurate Android touches from certain manufacturers (OnePlus, LG and Redmi). We've been working hard to include this fix, so these mobile users won't deal with this issue anymore. Engine users should also notice that we fixed the conversions of text to any numbers that were stored in variables because it greatly impacted the stored numbers in variables on Andriod, iOS and HTML5. 

[h2][b]Smoother Animations in the 3D Action-RPG Template[/b][/h2]

Apart from making Android fixes, users should see smoother animations in the 3D Action-RPG Template. We were able to fix the rendering overlaps and smooth out the animation stuttering. Additionally, we fixed the missing airplane animation as well. 

[h2][b]Log Messages Won't Disappear Over Time[/b][/h2]

Users have submitted reports that the log messages were not disappearing over time after executing custom events within the map/interface editors. We fixed that issued and hope that you take advantage in using custom events within the map/interface editors. As a quick reminder, we recently released a new feature from the previous update that enables users to click "list" option in custom events and network messages. Game developers who are making a life simulator game in a farm environment might find it beneficial to have a custom event that lists the animals, animal actions and more. 

[h2][b]Too Many Terraformations[/b][/h2]

We've gotten reports from folks who experienced an issue when creating too many terraformations. We've fixed the problem and wanted to mention that more users should often use the terraformation system. The tile terraformation window allows the user to utilize concave and convex tiles (as well as neighboring tiles as an option), which means that that the user can ultimately change how a pool of water should  be visually seen when it on the ground or grass tiles. Variability options (like color and rotation) are also available to the user when making a change in the terraformation. 

[h2][b]Map Boundary Connections & Party Crashes[/b][/h2]

After talking about terraformation, maybe some folks might want to create a race car game or a project involving vehicles. If so, game developers will be excited   to know that we corrected the vehicles for not properly responding to the map boundary connections. For engine users who are not interested involving any vehicles, we also fixed some crashes that focuses on the player or party. We fixed the crash when the user is changing the starting player's location in setting while no maps or interfaces are loaded, and we fixed the crash when attempting to remove a party member from an empty party.

[h2][b]Highlights from the Previous Updates[/b][/h2]

Please be sure to always check if you are using the latest version. We've fixed many things and continue to bring new changes. One of those changes include fixing graphics that turned into white squares after restarting a game in a built PC/Steam game. Another change includes improving the video card capability of 3D models with more than 40 bones when users reported seeing graphical glitches with 3D models in general. Besides getting an update that fixes issues, you gain some cool features as well. We expanded the script options for map events. These options include changing the maximum and minimum speed as well as the opacity for the clouds and rain. 

As always, we appreciate the continued support and feedback that we receive from both the community and our Patreons. You can view the full list of changes for the newest update and the previous ones from the changelog: https://001gamecreator.com/changes/

The new version (v2021.003.000) of 001 Game Creator is finally available! Thanks to the feedback from the community and our Patreons, we’re able to put together a great update. Download this new version now to access the new features, performance improvements and bug fixes. 

[h2]New Features - (New Use Values, List Option & GIF Import)[/h2]

Before this public release, the Patreon community first accessed the Beta version of this update (and other cool Patreon benefits that you can find [url=https://www.patreon.com/softweir]here[/url]). It includes new features, with one of them being a new “List” option to custom events and network messages. Now, you can create custom lists of options. The second new feature enables the user to access the list of the project’s globals through the “Global Variables Collection” and “Switches Collection” use values. The third feature enables the user to be able to import GIF files through the sprite editor when adding “Image Files”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/d8872b1373e59251b6010d4be16c52b97213abd4.png[/img]

[h2]New Map Weather Events & Improved Options[/h2]

Besides adding new features, we have also expanded the script options for map events, so users can create interesting atmospheres and captivating scenes on any map! These options include changing the maximum and minimum speed as well as the opacity for the clouds and rain. Users can also choose a script to change the cloud/rain sprites or the script to change wind direction. We have also greatly improved the range used for each weather slider, making it far easier to setup rain and clouds!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/cee9a6280160b4734293ac15561dbdc792746450.png[/img]

[h2]Text Scripting Codes Displayed on Wiki Pages (Use Values & Events)[/h2]

Besides updating the engine with cool new features and options, we’ve also updated our wiki pages to display text scripting codes. This is a useful reference for anyone using the text scripting mode, as you no longer have to convert graphical scripts to figure out text scripting codes! Check out the updated wiki pages here:
https://001gamecreator.com/wiki/events/
https://001gamecreator.com/wiki/usevalues/

[h2]Improved Video Card Capability (Resolved 3D Model/Bones Issues)[/h2]

Although we have implemented new things inside and outside of the engine, we’ve also worked on bugs/issues that were reported to us. These reports include graphical glitches with 3D models in general for some users. To resolve the issue, we improved the video card capability of 3D models with more than 40 bones. 

[h2]Saving Issues[/h2]

We’ve also gotten reports regarding when someone is saving and loading games. Fortunately, this new version will be able to resolve them. You can expect a fix for Android games loading incorrectly and games that have variables containing empty arrays crashing. We’ve even fixed the crash when loading a minimalistic saved game when equipment items are based on a template. 

[h2]Resolved Bug Fixes - (Lost Resources, MMORPG Connections & Android IDs)[/h2]

Apart from the major fixes mentioned above, we also handled other minor problems. Engine users will no longer lose resources when playing a built game that has restarted at least once, and they can now use underscores in Android IDs. In the MMORPG template, we fixed the error when the number of connections to the server exceeded 100. To improve the engine’s usability and performance, we removed all superfluous quotation marks from listings in graphical scripter event windows and made “Ignore Obstacles” as a default for lights.  

[h2]Recap on Previous Updates[/h2]

As a kind reminder, we’ve integrated some changes that are beneficial for all users, but you will need to download the latest version in order for you to experience them. That includes resolving bug issues and gaining access to new content. Here’s some highlights of those changes from the previous updates:
-Improved Map Performance (Large Maps)
-Actor AI Fixes (Water/Ramps/Walls)
-Graphical Glitch Fixes for Particle Effects (HTML5/Mobile)
-Updated Android API target version to 29 (now 30) to support latest Google Play Store requirements
-Fixed defeated player actors from being able to change direction or jump
-Fixed displaying the incorrect number of walls (wall height) in map editor
-Fixed the visual issues when climbing fences in the Platformer template
-Fixed displaying the incorrect number of walls (wall height) in map editor

As always, you can view the full list of changes for the newest update and the previous ones from the changelog:
https://001gamecreator.com/changes/

notes.title: End of Year Review
notes.content:
Although 2020 has been a rough year for everyone, there were some huge steps for 001 Game Creator. We will take a moment to reflect on some of these advancements now!

At the beginning of the year, things were pretty quiet on the surface. However, each of our team members were tackling various key tasks in the background setting up future releases. We provided various bug fixes and upgraded the font editor, setting up some groundwork for upcoming features. 

Later on, we released two of our biggest features that we started since the previous year. We’ve been working on implementing full UNICODE support within the engine. Our effort has finally pulled off, and the implementation can now support languages like Arabian, Chinese, Japanese and Russian. The team had to create entirely new UNICODE-compatible controls and then update each window in the engine to make use of them, which took a tremendous amount of time. Finally our worldwide audience could easily make their games in their own language!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/3601f1edc69ce721aa21f2248bb2ac1b6c6242bb.png[/img]

The next huge feature was adding the dark user interface (Dark UI), which has been requested immensely by the community. The Dark UI enables users to work on their projects in the engine in dark mode. If users would like to switch back to light mode, they could by accessing the “Tools” option.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/715a3462f7c3f1c7f4ff1d5ae92f71d8cc50b7ef.png[/img]

We have upgraded and expanded on the Platformer and Action RPG templates. The overhaul for the Action RPG changes introduced new interfaces and polish, like the Story Message and Picture-In-Picture. The Platformer template received a major update, including new art assets, game mechanics and a full demo. We also released a new resource DLC dedicated to various sound effects you can use in your projects!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/652c919b609c3db7fbb59f05b63283909f6e6ab4.png[/img]

In the midst of this year, 001 Game Creator has participated in two Humble Bundle events - one for game creators and the other event for a STEM educational content. The educational content includes two books, numerous worksheets and team/cost spreadsheets for game developers. The books cover the basics of using the engine and resources, in a way focused around STEM fundamentals.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/b31eeb550570466ce974494c14a0efb6b546ac07.png[/img]

Earlier this year we also setup our official [url=https://www.patreon.com/softweir]Patreon[/url] account. It allows the Patreon community to provide financial support to our upcoming projects and to gain benefits for actively contributing funds. One of those benefits include getting first access to watching a revamped video tutorial series and reading a text tutorial series called 001 Game Recipes. Patreons are responsible for picking which Game Recipes get made next by vote. If you pledge for long enough, you can even snag some exclusive SoftWeir swag! A huge thank you to all of our supporters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/69997f54d1ad8d0c0b27b11ffd2d78d5a9d32c46.png[/img]

Toward the end of the year, we launched our previous Humble Bundle educational contents in both digital and physical forms! You can pick up either a kindle or physical copy of the STEM courses on [url=https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08R3G5LYD]Amazon [/url] and the game design printable worksheets can be found here: https://www.softweir.ca/shop/. To top the year off, we even hit another mile-stone by welcoming our 1,000th Discord member!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/4d02c22b91d1caff9d84269544afca37b676afae.png[/img]

Although we love to deliver new features, we have also spent a huge amount of time resolving major issues reported to us by the community and our team. All throughout the year we have been fixing various issues and stability, as well as improving the codebase to improve performance. A shout out to our awesome community for helping us iron out these issues, and thank you for everyone’s patience!

We still have some new surprises in the pipeline, so always check back often! On behalf of the whole team, we want to wish you a Happy New Year! Thank you for your continued support, and we hope to see more amazing games from you in 2021!

notes.title: NEW Version (Map Performance, AI Fixes for Water/Ramps) + NEW Video Tutorials
notes.content:
The latest version of 001 Game Creator is now available, with a bunch of fixes and improvements based on reports/feedback we received from Humble Bundle users! Plus, a new video tutorial series is in the works - the first of which is now publicly available after having been exclusively available to our [url=https://www.patreon.com/softweir]Patrons[/url] for the past fortnight!

[h1]v2020.008.000[/h1]

We've updated 001 Game Creator to v2020.008.000 and with it comes a bunch of fixes and improvements based on the reports and feedback we received primarily from Humble Bundle users! As always, you can view the [url=https://001gamecreator.com/changes/]full changelog on our website[/url] but we've also highlighted a few of the changes below:

[h3]Improved Map Performance (Large Maps)[/h3]
We've improved the rendering of Maps to yield better performance, particularly with larger maps! This applies to both 2D and 3D projects. Several users who've had access to our beta version (you can support our [url=https://www.patreon.com/softweir]Patreon[/url] to to gain access to these) have already noticed improvements with their projects; Averaging 5-10fps gains on larger maps.

[h3]Actor AI Fixes (Water/Ramps/Walls)[/h3]
We've fixed Actor AI so that it now performs as expected when Actors are submerged in water or on ramps. We've also fixed issues with Actors getting stuck in water, walls or other Actors.

[h3]Fixed Tile-Set Extractor[/h3]
The Tile-Set Extractor was causing issues for some users, and with this update we've been able to resolve them! Specifically, we've fixed an issue regarding multi-selection of tiles as well as performance issues when using the Tile Size option.

[h3]Fixed Text Scripter[/h3]
A rare crash was discovered regarding our Text Scripter that has now been resolved, as well as an issue that prevented users from pressing up/down keys while editing a text script.

[h3]Fixed Use Value Tooltips / Fonts[/h3]
A bug that prevented Use Value tooltips from showing up has also been fixed, along with a fix for Fonts that were incorrectly rendering high-order UNICODE characters in-game.

[h3]Graphical Glitch Fixes for Particle Effects (HTML5/Mobile)[/h3]
Lastly, we've fixed a graphical glitch that only appeared with HTML5/Mobile games that resulted in particle effects from showing incorrectly.

[h1]NEW Video Tutorials[/h1]

In addition to updating 001 Game Creator, we're also pleased to announce that we've started a brand new video tutorial series which is designed to go over the basics of using 001 Game Creator; from providing a complete overview of all of the tools and features, to learning how to create your very first game with NPCs and quests! The first video in this new series has been available to our [url=https://www.patreon.com/softweir]Patrons[/url] for the past fortnight but it's now publicly available for everyone else!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1wtNVGNYNWw
As you've probably guessed, this new series will replace some of our older video tutorials that covered similar topics (but didn't go into nearly as much detail). We've also got another video tutorial series planned (once this current one is finished) that will look specifically at resources.

Video tutorials are frequently requested by our users and, thanks in part to our new [url=https://www.patreon.com/softweir]Patrons[/url], we'll finally be able to start producing these on a regular basis. So, you can look forward to seeing many more video tutorials in the coming months!

notes.title: v2020.007.000 Released! (NEW RPG/Platformer Templates, Finalised Dark UI)
notes.content:
We've updated 001 Game Creator to v2020.007.000 which features completely new and updated Action-RPG and Platformer templates, as well as a finalised version of our Dark UI!

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

Our biggest change with this new update is the complete overhaul of our Action-RPG and Platformer game templates. We've received many questions on our Discord server, and other social networks, about how to do or create certain things in 001, and so we decided to expand upon our original game templates to include the types of features people frequently ask about.

Let's go over some of the changes to each template!

[h2]Action-RPG Template[/h2]

The first thing you'll notice about this updated template is that the previously separate "RPG Demo" has been incorporated into the main template itself (with a bunch of updates of course!) This means that instead of just a single empty "Starting Map", there's actually some substantial content to actually work with right out of the gate!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/75ab9c012a55e66a9d88e2823fda13ea9429feca.png[/img]
A new "Story Message" Interface has been added that can be used to inform the player about certain objectives and story elements. These messages have a cinematic look to them and will also auto-close after a set amount of time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/78a7f2bb61476b7b33c8acb6bf373bdad79843f4.png[/img]
A new Picture-in-Picture Interface has also been added to show the Forest Map when receiving the quest to defeat the slimes that inhabit it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/17472654a9a6f6db01153546bfedc71e8ae7ca06.png[/img]
Numerous tweaks to lighting, weather effects, and other Map elements have also been made to make these areas stand out more and to better showcase 001's feature set.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/262c5bfaacbf3dcdffaffaacde37eec7182ab0db.png[/img]
Two new magic spells (Cure and Fireball) have been added to the player's main arsenal - with accompanying sound effects and sprites. When entering the Forest Map, you'll be given the option to either equip the Cure spell or the Fireball spell.

[h2]Platformer Template[/h2]

The template that's received the biggest overhaul though is the Platformer template. Previously, this template was very barren in content and we've received a lot of questions about this template in particular, so we've given it a much needed spruce up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/9a969f9bc0055bff772d7d9fc8a0297b221170ab.png[/img]
Ladders have been added that the player can climb up/down on to reach higher/lower ledges. There's even a moving ladder (pictured to the right) that the player has to carefully time as to not fall into the deadly spikes beneath!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/36bd08ffbe9070ba98d063e805a5f7bd3d755ff9.png[/img]
Moving platforms (utilising an Actor's "Sticky Platform" physics) allow for quick and easy methods of traversal across perilous obstacles, like the lava pit seen here.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/1b8edfc33d87c6443c5ec1d07b8674971e54207b.png[/img]
Bottomless pits are a staple in any platform game, and we've even added a comical death animation for when the player character loses a life.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/e33eef63419eece21632aafc8c0cc82365ed35d5.png[/img]
Chain-link fences provide an alternative traversal method to ladders - allowing players to move side-to-side instead of just up/down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/e0db25d65d4bbb9320a235b6f1e544a49bcbb09b.png[/img]
Pressure-sensitive platforms activate when the player steps on them, and sink when the player jumps off them. Enemies utilise different Actor Route types to demonstrate how Tile-Based and Direction-Point routes can be used.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/9aea59dccc585e056c5d2e3070b6ad40d3f5b5ba.png[/img]
Parallax backgrounds/foregrounds and Map Layers showcase the breadth of visual effects that can be achieved in 001 Game Creator! Can you escape the castle and rescue the princess at the end?

[h1]Bug Fixes and Finalised Dark UI[/h1]

In addition to these newly updated templates, we've also fixed several reported bugs and also finalised our Dark UI - which we released in our last major update. There were a few teething problems that needed to be ironed out but thankfully (with the help of our community) we've managed to resolve all of the outstanding issues with the Dark UI update. 

We've also updated all of our music to use the OGG format instead of MIDI for better mobile/web compatibility, as well as improved quality and performance.

Here are just some of the highlights of this release:

[list]
[*] Fixed "Advanced Message Box" choices from being interpreted as values instead of text.
[*] Added "Face Direction of Movement" option to point-based actor routes.
[*] Made "Change Facing Direction Based on Movement" event have no effect when an actor is disabled, further preventing actors from being manipulated by input.
[*] Fixed "Connection to Accessories" being reset for sprite resources.
[*] Fixed new lighting from disappearing for large sprites at edges.
[*] Fixed crash when undoing while editing an alternative interface layout.
[*] Fixed zone blocking not saving properly sometimes.
[*] Fixed taskbar icon disappearing in random cases.
[*] Fixed being able to delete inherited actor variables.
[*] Added Ladders, Fences, One-Way Platforms and Collectables to template "Platformer".
[*] Added new clothing options for "Player Character" in "Platformer" template including new poses.
[*] Added new parallax background sprites to the template "Platformer".
[*] Added new tile-sets to the template "Platformer" and updated existing ones.
[*] Fixed broken accessory connections in the template "Action-RPG".
[*] Added "Heal" and "Fireball" magic to the template "Action-RPG".
[*] Updated all built-in music to be OGG instead of MIDI.
[/list]

As per usual, you can see our full list of changes on our change log here:
https://001gamecreator.com/changes/

notes.title: NEW Version (Dark UI, Full UNICODE Support)
notes.content:
We've just released a new version of 001 Game Creator featuring the new Dark UI and full UNICODE support that we announced last month!

[h1]What's New?[/h1]

001 Game Creator has been updated to v2020.006.000 and with it comes a bunch of new changes and bug fixes. The two main additions in this release are of course the aforementioned Dark UI and full UNICODE support - which have been highly requested by members of our community for a very long time now. We're glad to finally have these features implemented!

[h2]Dark UI[/h2]

By default, when you start 001 Game Creator, the engine will be in Dark Mode. You can revert back to Light Mode by going into the Tools > Options window. In addition to the new darker theme, we've also changed the main editor font to Verdana to give 001 a more modern appearance, and exposed the graphics used in the Script Editor to allow users to more greatly customise that window!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/33c092c118523250d9312fcb29a8203b64b41b76.png[/img]

[h2]Full UNICODE Support[/h2]

At long last, 001 Game Creator now fully supports UNICODE characters throughout the engine! This means that 001 can finally be translated into languages that were once deemed impossible including Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Arabic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/168d2318bc184bbceeb37f7a12c2ff208cce1835.png[/img]

[h3]Translators Wanted[/h3]

With 001 now fully supporting UNICODE characters, this of course means that 001 can now feature languages that it once couldn't, and so we're on the lookout for some volunteers who are willing to help us translate 001 into new languages. Specifically we're looking for translators for Russian, Chinese, Japanese and Arabic. If this is something you feel you can help with then please apply using our translator's contact form: https://001gamecreator.com/translation/

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

With any new release, there are of course a bunch of bug fixes (including several Map Construction crash fixes). As always, you can view the full change log on our website: https://001gamecreator.com/changes/ but we wanted to highlight some of the more significant changes here:

[list]
[*] Fixed large scaled actors from disappearing on the edges of the screen.
[*] Fixed tile-set editor's collision and material editors from not having complete focus.
[*] Fixed crash when using "Simulated Control" use value under "Main Party / Game".
[*] Fixed crash when map's fog distance end is too low.
[*] Fixed crash when changing actor template while a trigger is running.
[*] Fixed "Face Direction of Actor" actor event.
[*] Fixed y-axis version of "Face Direction of Location" actor event.
[*] Fixed crash when attempting to edit a collection or table that contains a nested collection.
[*] Fixed not calling custom events that had "main", "relate" or "this" as its last or only argument.
[*] Fixed local help file not being displayed sometimes.
[*] Fixed crash when opening a custom event that has a parameter changed to a text/branch cluster.
[*] Fixed font editor freezing computer with large UNICODE blocks.
[*] Fixed not being able to uncheck "CJK Unified Ideographs (All)" in font editor.
[*] Fixed "not returning value" custom event errors from highlighting incorrect node in script debugger.
[*] Fixed script debugger from highlighting incorrect node when stepping through loop iterations.
[*] Fixed crash when quickly switching between maps and interfaces.
[*] Fixed not being able to get cursor positions from secondary screen touches on Android/iOS.
[*] Fixed certain crashes when windows were not being properly forced in front.
[*] Fixed Steam not shutting down software properly after having done any Android builds.
[*] Fixed Android/iOS testing app from crashing after first game tested.
[*] Fixed Android screen orientation change issues.
[/list]

[h1]Community Guides[/h1]
Lastly, we wanted to take this opportunity to remind users of our user-created Steam Guides: https://steamcommunity.com/app/347400/guides/ which provides an extra source of learning material in addition to our video tutorials, online wiki and built-in demos/examples.

Some of our legacy tutorials (that were originally removed from the engine for being outdated) are currently being revised and will be posted to our Steam Guides section in the coming days, so be sure to check them out once they're posted!

notes.title: End of Year Review, New Version, and Steam Winter Sale
notes.content:
With 2019 coming to a close, it's time to reflect on all of the amazing stuff this year! We also have a new version of 001 Game Creator for you, and our biggest sale yet!

[h1]Steam Winter Sale[/h1]
First and foremost, we have an amazing deal for you this Christmas as 001 Game Creator has a whopping 80% discount in the Steam Winter Sale, which will run from Today until the 2nd January 2020! But that's not all, as ALL of our DLC Kits are also 40% off as well! This is the biggest sale we've ever had for 001 Game Creator, so make sure to get it before the sale ends!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/951950/001_Game_Creator__Retro_Fantasy_Music_Pack_Volume_1/

[h1]New Version (v2019.005.002)[/h1]
We've also updated 001 Game Creator to v2019.005.002 which some important updates/changes that we want to go over:

[list]
[*]Built 'Windows Installer' games now require NSIS to be installed (see our new dedicated [url=https://001gamecreator.com/wiki/build/]Build Game page[/url] on our Wiki for instructions). This change should help resolve the false positives we've been seeing from certain anti-virus software. It also has the added benefit of allowing us to more easily implement specific installer options/customisations. Something we'll be looking into for 2020...
[*]The 'Windows Plain Files' build option now includes 'Redist001.exe' to assist with DLL registration. This is super useful for those wishing to create portable versions of their games (without needing it to be installed)
[*]Added an alternative animated shader supporting up to 128 bones (up from 40) for 3D models. This will be extremely useful to those of you making 3D games.
[*]Fixed importing of FBX 7.5 3D model files.
[*]Made "holding point 1", "holding_point_1" or something ending with those, acceptable bone names for 3D model holding points.
[*]Made Actors without the "Fly" option enabled to still be able to move backwards when their Z position is greater than 0.
[*]Fixed the resource importer from not being able to import graphics/audio from files/folders containing UNICODE characters. However, keep in mind that drag and dropping files is still limited.
[*]Added a warning when building games for mobile/HTML5 when there is compatible audio resources (since many users weren't aware of this, and why their apps were randomly crashing as a result).
[*]Renamed "3D Action-Adventure" demo to "3D Adventure (First Person View)" to increase awareness. Yes, that's right - we have free demos included with the software!
[*]Added "Zoom Scale Ratio" and "Disable Lighting" to "Add Parallax" event.
[/list]

As always, you can view the full change log on our website [url=http://001gamecreator.com/changes/]here[/url].

[h1]End of Year Review[/h1]
It's been an eventful year for us in 2019 and given that this is our last major update of the year, we wanted to take the time to reflect on all of things that came out this year.

At the beginning of the year we made a huge change to 001, with the implementation of full UNICODE support - one of our most requested features! Since then, we've continued to make improvements and will further improve this in 2020 so that all aspects of 001 fully support UNICODE characters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/b1b298e2f87759bbee6849b6e4f3af9efa51a349.png[/img]

We added a screenshot capture mode that allows you to take screenshots of your game using Alt+P that can then be exported as PNG files or submitted directly to our web server, where it can be promoted freely across our social media platforms - A great way to get more eyes on your 001 games!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/3bb2c1a2e05c8ab2bdb962090f4fe4852de31d28.png[/img]

We released a brand new DLC Kit - Our Visual Novel Kit, a highly requested template that allows visual novels and 'choose your own adventure' style games to be made with ease. And it's currently on sale for 40% off in the Steam Winter Sale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/09412d360f8b12eb161fdfc64ba70a6692b9fa99.png[/img]

...But that's not all because we also released our first resource pack - Dragon's Den which added a bunch of new Sprites, Tile-Sets and Music/Sounds for use in your 001 projects. Incidentally, this resource pack is also 40% off in the Steam Winter Sale!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/4a459554436060aef020f53f6bf0d8a97e7d77ff.png[/img]

We gave Android builds a complete overhaul, making them far more robust and adding support for both 32-bit and 64-bit modules, whilst increasing the API Level to 28. This change has brought us one step closer towards implementing Ads and IAPs that have been highly requested by the community, and we're pleased to announce that these additions will finally be arriving in 2020!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/73ad0121c0027eaf676be8328146ab399ed81156.png[/img]

We also started some early work on a Dark UI for 001 Game Creator - another feature that is highly requested. While there is still much more work that needs to be done, we hope to have this feature implemented next year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/9df42c5d61ae380da11c1732a4e3c70a0d417c06.png[/img]
[i]A VERY early test at getting a Dark UI working in 001. Not representative of the final look.[/i]

On top of all of these additions, we've also spent the last year fixing numerous bugs, implementing various quality of life improvements, and adding many smaller features that have been requested by our community. We hope to continue this trend moving forward in order to make 2020 an even better year for 001 Game Creator! We have a lot of cool stuff in the pipeline, so we hope you look forward to seeing what we've got in store for the future!

Until then, on behalf of everyone on the team, we'd like to wish you all a Merry Christmas, and a Happy New Year! Thank you all for your continued support over the past year. We hope to see even more amazing games from you in the new year!

notes.title: Android Build Update, Upcoming Features and Week-long Sale
notes.content:
We've got some exciting news to share about Android deployment, new features in the pipeline and a week-long sale too!

[h1]Android Build Update[/h1]
We've been doing some work behind the scenes in order to bring Android builds up-to-date. In the latest version (2019.003.004) we've increased the API Level to 28 and both 32-bit and 64-bit modules are now supported.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/73ad0121c0027eaf676be8328146ab399ed81156.png[/img]

Something cool we want to highlight: We've made a change to Map Connections so that they now also position vehicles containing players! 

Of course we've fixed a few bugs and made some minor tweaks too, as we often do, so make sure you check out our full [url=http://001gamecreator.com/changes/]change log[/url] on our website.

[h1]Upcoming Features[/h1]
Our feature requests vote box has been a huge success and thanks to this we now have a better idea of what it is you'd like to see implemented into 001. Today, we'd like to announce some of the things we're working on that I think you'll be pretty pleased about:

[b][u]IAP/Ads for Android/iOS[/u][/b]
Easily one of our most requested features - the ability to add IAPs and Ads for Android and iOS games. Well, part of the reason why we updated the Android build is because of this! Now that our Android build is a lot more robust, implementing these features won't be nearly as difficult. While we can't give an exact date as to when this will be available, we can say that it's now one step closer to being added. Look forward to learning more about this in the near future!

[b][u]Dark UI[/u][/b]
Something else a lot of you seem interested in is a Dark UI for 001's main graphical user interface. We're still very much in the early stages of implementing this but here's a quick test we did a short while ago:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/9370680/9df42c5d61ae380da11c1732a4e3c70a0d417c06.png[/img]
[i]NOTE: This is not what the final Dark UI will look like - this was only a simple test to see if it was possible.[/i]

[b][u]UNICODE Improvements[/u][/b]
A few months back, we added UNICODE support to 001 however, while successful, it's still fairly bare bones - as there are parts of the editor that do not support UNICODE characters. We're going to be continuing our efforts for full UNICODE support in future updates, so please look forward to it!

[h1]Week-long Sale[/h1]
Lastly, from [b]now until November 1st[/b] we're running a week-long sale on 001 Game Creator and its various DLC Kits - with 001 being 70% off and ALL our DLC Kits being 30% off!

notes.title: New Version - UNICODE Improvements and Startup Crash Fixes
notes.content:
We've updated 001 Game Creator to v2019.001.003 which includes some very important fixes to our initial UNICODE implementation and mobile builds!

[h1]UNICODE Implementation Fixes[/h1]

In our last announcement, we revealed our first implementation of UNICODE support in 001 Game Creator (a long-time requested feature from our community). Since then, we've worked with our users on refining this implementation - most notably in fixing an issue with certain international configurations of Windows that would cause characters to display incorrectly.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/b1b298e2f87759bbee6849b6e4f3af9efa51a349.png[/img]

Additionally, we've made it easier to add/remove certain blocks of characters to your fonts with the appropriately named "Add Block" and "Remove Block" buttons. There's even a "Custom" option, where you can specify a UNICODE hex range to add specific groups of characters!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/6a26ece88cfed135439781665caa29b1b9f22dd6.png[/img]

We will continue to improve our UNICODE implementation over the coming weeks/months so that all necessary parts of the engine can display these characters correctly. We'd also like to thank those of you that have been helping us to improve our UNICODE implementation!

[h1]Numerous Editor Start Up Crash Fixes[/h1]

While working to re-create the UNICODE problems some users were experiencing, we noticed several areas where 001 Game Creator would crash upon start up if the user's video card didn't properly support windowed swap chains, advanced material shaders, texture colour mapping, or large textures used by system fonts.

If you've previously experienced crashes when starting 001 Game Creator then these fixes should make a huge difference!

[h1]Android/iOS Build Fixes[/h1]

Another important fix in this update is the Android/iOS build functionality that wasn't working as intended. You should now be able to build your game for Android and iOS without issue - we've also fixed an issue where built APK files would crash upon start up!

Additionally, for those of you with larger games, we've fixed an issue that resulted in an error during the build process.

As always, you can see a full list of changes here: http://001gamecreator.com/changes/

We've got some exciting news to share with you all today - including the announcement of an extended Steam Lunar Sale and a new version of 001 Game Creator with our initial implementation of UNICODE support!

[h1]EXTENDED Steam Lunar Sale![/h1]

From [b]February 4th to February 18th[/b] 001 Game Creator will be [b]60% off[/b] - with our MMORPG, 3D FPS and Point & Click Adventure DLC Kits being [b]30% off[/b] and our Retro Music Pack being [b]15% off[/b]. https://store.steampowered.com/app/951950/001_Game_Creator__Retro_Fantasy_Music_Pack_Volume_1/?snr=1_5_9__405

[h1]Full UNICODE Support (Beta)[/h1]

Perhaps one of the most requested features, and also one of the most challenging features to implement, is the ability to fully support UNICODE characters to allow for foreign languages like Russian and Chinese (which previously weren't supported).

With 001 being built on VB6 (which doesn't natively support UNICODE characters) this was always seen as an impossible feature request...That is until now! We'll spare you the boring technical details and just say that a new discovery was recently found that would allow 001 to support these characters with only a little work on our end - and so we're pleased to announce that UNICODE support is finally available in 001 Game Creator! 

[b]However, since this is still only our first implementation, we'd like to hear input/feedback from our community! There are also still some things not implemented to support UNICODE fully in some parts of the engine.[/b]

(Some screenshots showcasing Russian characters):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/24a062eaf58ad4d112f665d69031a23dfb5fe034.png[/img]

[i]Please Note: You'll need to explicitly add UNICODE characters to your font files first - otherwise they won't be recognised in-game![/i]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/acb549dfb3d4214097769431b06e8e36813187d1.png[/img]

[h1]Improvements To Fonts[/h1]

Our UNICODE implementation has also had an added benefit to fonts in general as we've now managed to pack characters in better which means that the padding option is no longer necessary in most cases. As such, the look of characters will appear more natural than before (where spacing wasn't being properly obeyed)

We've also enlarged font images from 2048x1024 to 2048x2048 so that fonts can store more characters!

[h1]A Few Smaller User-Requested Features[/h1]

While UNICODE support is one of the largest feature requests implemented in this version - we've also taken the time to implement a few smaller requests that didn't require much time to add. These include:

[b]Change Reverse, Rising and Falling Speed Events[/b] - Three new events that change the Reverse Speed, Rising Speed and Falling Speed of Actors has been added.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/0b5eac277c4c2d8d47da666d02c31586496dcd53.png[/img]

[b]Screen Size/Orientation Changed Interface Trigger[/b] - A brand new Interface Trigger has been added that runs whenever the size of the game window is changed (Windows/HTML5) or when the orientation of the screen is changed (iOS/Android).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/a61e831b1e2a97bcbe9c585a4d41265c0986fdfe.png[/img]

[b]Change Currency Symbol Visual Setting[/b] - You can now effortlessly change the currency symbol used for Money by going to Game Settings > Visual Settings. This is also useful, given the implementation of UNICODE and the various different types of currencies used around the globe.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/f8ed3d8fb4b59417514ebfbc0dee1f9f60099088.png[/img]

notes.title: New Version, Windows 10 Crash Fix and Price Reduction for Services
notes.content:
We've updated 001 Game Creator to fix a critical crash some Windows 10 users were experiencing. We've also made some additional changes/added some new things that we've documented below.

[h1]v1.020.010[/h1]

[b]Windows 10 Crash Fix[/b] - We've recently fixed an issue that resulted in some Windows 10 users experiencing crashes when opening certain editor windows. If you've been experiencing random crashes while using Windows 10 then this update should hopefully address that issue!

[b]Android Build Update[/b] - We've updated game building for Android which now requires the Android SDK/NDK to be installed in addition to Java Development Kit (JDK). This now means that Android games can be distributed to the Amazon App Store and other store fronts that require a DEX file to be generated.

[b]NEW Screenshot Capture/Manager[/b] - We've added a new screenshot capture tool to the Game Debugger that allows you to effortless screenshot your game while testing. All of the captured screenshots are then stored inside a manager (which will launch automatically after closing your game). You can also submit them to our website by entering your email address and providing a brief description.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/def2f4e4fcdd7f642cb7e6a1b896bdb7cea2b7a5.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/3bb2c1a2e05c8ab2bdb962090f4fe4852de31d28.png[/img]

[b]NEW Reset Interface When Screen Changes[/b] - Lastly, we've added a new Interface Properties option to automatically reset an Interface when the screen size changes. This feature is useful for Interfaces with alternate layouts - as it now means Interfaces can update when a mobile device's orientation is changed or when a Windows form is resized without needing to manually reset the Interface. It also works with HTML5 games too (when resizing the browser window)!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/5f87a8923bbdf516f8c1c5d9c3b5909745e9b128.png[/img]

For a full list of changes, please see our change log here: https://001gamecreator.com/changes/

[h1]Service Price Changes[/h1]

To usher in the new year, we're also updating our tutoring and scripting service pricing [b]from $40/hr to $25/hr[/b]! To schedule some one on one training please visit: https://001gamecreator.com/product/software-training/

To see a full list of all the service we offer visit: https://001gamecreator.com/services/

notes.title: Turn-Based Battles Are Finally Here! (Enhanced RPG Kit)
notes.content:
Yes, at long last, we are ready to unveil our new [b]Enhanced RPG Kit[/b] that features a fully functional Turn-Based Battle System!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/977250

First and foremost, check out the updated "New Game" window that will appear when creating a new project. We've separated all DLC Kits into their own list (to the right) and merged all the built-in projects and demo games in the list to the left.

[i]We've also added a small blurb to remind our users that DLC Kits [b]DO NOT[/b] restrict functionality - meaning you can freely create an MMORPG without the MMORPG Kit or create a 3D FPS without the 3D FPS / Survival Horror Kit![/i]

Now let's get to the juicy stuff, the Enhanced RPG Kit itself!

While turn-based battles are an exciting part of this new DLC kit, it's not the only thing RPG fans will come to appreciate. We've overhauled a ton of built-in systems specifically for this kit including (but not limited to):

[h1]NEW User Interface/HUD[/h1]

We've given the default user interface and player HUD an extensive make over in the Enhanced RPG Kit! Take a look:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/af0a2081ff38a55fcd2d405c6464ad7e901ac399.png[/img]

[h1]NEW Quest System[/h1]

The Enhanced RPG Kit also features a fancy new quest system that allows users to effortlessly setup all kinds of fun and interesting quests for players to embark on. There's even a quest menu where you can see all of your active and completed quests - now that's useful!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/86e6d27b27db20094f03d1211f38ebfff0a4f47c.png[/img]

[h1]NEW Turn-Based Battle System[/h1]

OK! We know this is what you're really here for! Yes, with the Enhanced RPG Kit you can create both Action-RPG battles and Turn-Based battles! [h1]And So Much More![/h1]

We've barely begun to scratch the surface with everything this kit has to offer. For the full list of features be sure to check out the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/977250]Enhanced RPG Kit Store Page[/url][/b]

notes.title: New Website & New Version!
notes.content:
We have a new version of 001 that fixes a whole bunch of issues and also a brand new website that we're finally unveiling to the public!

[h1]NEW Website[/h1]

After many months of hard work, we've finally built a [b][url=https://www.engine001.com]brand new website for 001![/url][/b] Our old website was looking pretty dated, and a lot of the information was similarly out of date, so we've spent some time creating this new website to provide users with a better experience and to also introduce a host of new services in the process!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/166b957992247dceb6d14a21a1e69fc1bfae4421.png[/img]

[b]NEW Standalone Version[/b] - We used to offer a cheaper subscription version of 001 that required users to pay a monthly fee to continue using its features however on numerous occasions we noticed Steam users asking whether they needed a subscription on top of their one-time purchase. It's this confusion which led us to offering a standalone version instead. The standalone version has the same exact features, at the same price as the Steam version but without needing Steam itself.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/1e431a86ec80ef44d2d5721af60705dff8d23a8a.png[/img]

[b]NEW Game Submission[/b] - Our new game submission system allows you to showcase your 001-created games with the world! It also allows for HTML5 games to be submitted and played directly on our website!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/ca72e76ef589d13202955fd0b9efde53b59c1f8f.png[/img]

[b]NEW Services[/b] - On top of that, we've introduced a whole bunch of new services that we'll be offering starting today! These paid services range from one-on-one support to asset creation and even full game publishing/optimisation! Whether you need some assistance where you can speak directly to another person or you need some graphics/music to be created to sprue up your project or you need help publishing and marketing your game on platforms like Steam, then we've got you covered!

Also, all services are currently listed at introductory prices!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/3fced99dba5efcf90daf60132bd31231b09583a7.png[/img]

[h1]NEW Version (v1.020.003)[/h1]

We've also updated 001 Game Creator to v1.020.003 which contains a host of bug fixes as well as a couple of new additions and changes. Here are some highlights:

[b]- Added importing/exporting of TXT/CSV files for Collection and Table editors respectively.[/b]

[b]- Added "Retrieve Position X/Y" options for Fields.[/b]

[b]- Made it warn in log when projectiles instantly hit the ground, with a legacy option to disable it; will never show up in built games.[/b]

[b]- Fixed AI Actors not going back to post when enemy is too far (it was also not properly triggering "Lost enemy" in that case).[/b]

[b]- Improved game load times, especially on HTML5[/b]

The following all generally encompass that Actor movement has been resolved in several ways:

[b]- Fixed collision/walking bugs introduced in last version, by properly fixing flat Actors going through the ground.[/b]

[b]- Applied smooth Actor auto-climbing to event/AI-based movement and velocity based movements.[/b]

[b]- Made Actor auto-climbing higher when Actor's speed is higher.[/b]

You can see the full list of changes at this new location here: https://engine001.com/changes/

[h1]Until Next Time...[/h1]

We're still hard at work on our upcoming Turn-Based RPG Template and will have more details to share with you soon! As always, we appreciate your continued support of this project and we hope you're looking forward to seeing what we have coming down the pipeline in the upcoming months!

notes.title: MMORPG Tutorials and New Version
notes.content:
At long last the MMORPG video tutorial series is finished and available for your viewing pleasure. We've also updated 001 with a bunch of cool additions that we've detailed below.

[h1]MMORPG Video Tutorials[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/ab1afd147b1c3b9297d3e0b39454c8d14c4410d6.png[/img]

In this four-part series, you'll learn how online multiplayer games work, how to properly setup your server, how to create different types of NPC Actors, how to create Item/Kill Quests as well as how to create console commands and build your game.

You can watch the full series on our official YouTube channel here: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLgohPz-X6YwhOamgHq95xH0OQjiZp36d4

Since this series relies heavily on the [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/564680/001_Game_Creator__MMORPG_Kit/]MMORPG DLC Kit[/url][/b], you'll also need to purchase and install this if you haven't done so already.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/564680/001_Game_Creator__MMORPG_Kit/

[h1]NEW Version (v1.020.001)[/h1]

A new version of 001 Game Creator is now available, with a host of bug fixes and cool additions, some of which have been detailed below:

- [b]NEW "Billboard (3D)" Tile Shape[/b] - This is a fairly big addition as it makes isometric games considerably simpler to build and 2D billboards in 3D games will no longer require Actors. Before, users would be required to use Actors for basically everything in 3D/isometric projects (which isn't very performance efficient). Thanks to this new addition this is no longer the case!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/a2c8fedaf94b50d848ddacf2ce30f5127904337a.png[/img]

We've also made it possible to rotate the camera vertically in isometric projects and made it possible to use the "Save 3D Perspective" Map option for these projects as well.

- [b]NEW Item/Magic Resource Constants[/b] - These are similar to Variables and are used to define special values for Items/Magic. Like with other properties of resources, these values cannot be changed through scripting but these values may be retrieved through scripting ("Constant" and "Constants Collection" Item/Magic use values). These are super useful when doing things like status effects, which will be a part of our upcoming Turn-Based Battle DLC Kit.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/d921f1eab2ba0ed308a851f88fcf6eedb62d7c9f.png[/img]

As per usual, you can find the full list of changes here: https://www.engine001.com/changes.htm

[h1]Until Next Time...[/h1]

We hope you enjoy these new additions and also our MMORPG video tutorial series. We're always listening to community feedback on how we can improve the engine further and what we should be working on next, so please feel free to continue making suggestions that you think will benefit 001 and the 001 community!

notes.title: NEW RPG Video Tutorial Series Launched!
notes.content:
Last year we mentioned that we'd begun creating a new video tutorial series that would show new users how to create a fully functional game from start to finish. 

I'm pleased to announce that our five-part RPG Series is now finished and has launched on our official YouTube channel!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/01dd3a8bd561d9f3ad1b1ade19fc707d75e53c3b.png[/img]

[h1]Watch on YouTube[/h1]

[b]Full YouTube Playlist: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLgohPz-X6YwiwPdOLdgc-9GQc369ZzKCF[/b]

[i]Note: You can click on the "Subtitles/closed captions" button in the bottom-right of the YouTube video player to enable subtitles.[/i]

In the span of just over 30 minutes, you'll learn how to create your first Map with some moving NPCs, create quests and cut-scenes, customise the player's appearance and attributes, add gamepad support and new resources, create a main menu and customise the HUD, build your game for others to play and more!

[h1]Share your feedback![/h1]

As always, we're interested in hearing the thoughts and suggestions of our community - not only on these tutorials (and how we might possibly improve upon them) but also your suggestions on other series you'd like to see covered in the future!

[b]If you have a game/genre you'd like to see a video tutorial series on, then please leave a comment with your suggestion![/b]

[h1]More on the way![/h1]

In the mean time, I can confirm that a sixth "Bonus" video tutorial for the RPG Series is currently in the works. After finishing the pre-planned five-part series we realised that we could cover a few extra topics that new users might find particularly useful. We hope to have this new video tutorial ready within the next fortnight so stay tuned!

[h1]NEW Version (v1.019.002)[/h1]

Alongside the sale, we've also updated 001 Game Creator with a bunch of awesome additions and bug fixes. Here are some of the highlights and, as always, you can see the full change log here: http://www.engine001.com/changes.htm

[h1]Tooltips[/h1]

It took a while but we've finally added tooltips to all major windows and their respective sub-windows in 001! Our [b][url=http://www.engine001.com/wiki/]Help Wiki[/url][/b] will always have the most detailed explanations but these tooltips should provide users (particularly newcomers) with some much needed help in understanding what all of these options/controls actually do.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/189471632b52370f24c97e398ac084263e8a2c20.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/7184a8856f00ae70bffb3720ee8c173e4a1d44b5.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/4251cb5d0a05402a2f9a91273857b9096d507690.png[/img]

[h1]Engine Performance Stuttering Resolved[/h1]

This crucial fix has resulted in improved smoothness in higher framerate games and has consequently improved the accuracy of Spawns/Timers!

[h1]Fixed Framerate / Time Stepping[/h1]

A new option inside the Game Settings window which allows game timing to be more predictable, resulting in more consistent gameplay regardless of game performance. Essentially, this tells your game that the FPS is always whatever you've set so if there's a hiccup, it'll run the game X number of times until it's caught up. This should help to resolve collision detection issues (Actors falling through floors, doors, walls, etc. when they're not supposed to)

PLEASE NOTE: If your game already suffers from performance issues, then this setting may make things worse! It's also advised that the "Minimum Framerate" option is set to nothing lower than 30.

[h1]Games Showcase[/h1]

Be sure to follow the official [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/001gamecreator/]001 Game Creator Instagram[/url][/b] account to see new posts every Monday, Thursday and Saturday showcasing the awesome games made in 001! Here's some of the things you've been missing:

We'd like to thank all of you for your continued support throughout the year and we hope you all have a happy holiday and new year! We'll be back in 2018 with even more cool updates for 001 Game Creator, so look forward to it! :)

[h1]NEW Version (v1.019.002)[/h1]

Alongside the sale, we've also updated 001 Game Creator with a bunch of awesome additions and bug fixes. Here are some of the highlights and, as always, you can see the full change log here: http://www.engine001.com/changes.htm

[h1]Tooltips[/h1]

It took a while but we've finally added tooltips to all major windows and their respective sub-windows in 001! Our [b][url=http://www.engine001.com/wiki/]Help Wiki[/url][/b] will always have the most detailed explanations but these tooltips should provide users (particularly newcomers) with some much needed help in understanding what all of these options/controls actually do.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/189471632b52370f24c97e398ac084263e8a2c20.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/7184a8856f00ae70bffb3720ee8c173e4a1d44b5.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/4251cb5d0a05402a2f9a91273857b9096d507690.png[/img]

[h1]Engine Performance Stuttering Resolved[/h1]

This crucial fix has resulted in improved smoothness in higher framerate games and has consequently improved the accuracy of Spawns/Timers!

[h1]Fixed Framerate / Time Stepping[/h1]

A new option inside the Game Settings window which allows game timing to be more predictable, resulting in more consistent gameplay regardless of game performance. Essentially, this tells your game that the FPS is always whatever you've set so if there's a hiccup, it'll run the game X number of times until it's caught up. This should help to resolve collision detection issues (Actors falling through floors, doors, walls, etc. when they're not supposed to)

PLEASE NOTE: If your game already suffers from performance issues, then this setting may make things worse! It's also advised that the "Minimum Framerate" option is set to nothing lower than 30.

[h1]Games Showcase[/h1]

Be sure to follow the official [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/001gamecreator/]001 Game Creator Instagram[/url][/b] account to see new posts every Monday, Thursday and Saturday showcasing the awesome games made in 001! Here's some of the things you've been missing:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/33b23037f533c8b21aeabb645242ffecbb9771bc.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/204be34b05bbbbc9682ac1c07fbce5765b64f040.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy New Year![/h1]

We'd like to thank all of you for your continued support throughout the year and we hope you all have a happy holiday and new year! We'll be back in 2018 with even more cool updates for 001 Game Creator, so look forward to it! :)
