notes.title: Point & Click Adventure Kit RELEASED!
notes.content:
Today we're pleased to announce that our long-awaited [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/567360/001_Game_Creator__Point__Click_Adventure_Kit/]Point & Click Adventure Kit[/url][/b] is now available on Steam! This new DLC template provides you with everything needed to start building your own PnC Adventures!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/567360/001_Game_Creator__Point__Click_Adventure_Kit/

With the launch of our new [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/567360/001_Game_Creator__Point__Click_Adventure_Kit/]Point & Click Adventure Kit[/url][/b] comes a brand new version of 001 Game Creator. This new update is mostly bug fixes but a few small additions have also been made, including the ability to specify an Android version code (to help facilitate APK updates on the Google Play store) and a new "Comment" event that can be placed inside scripts to let other developers know what your script is doing. We've also made 001 automatically launch Steam, if launching from an executable and Steam isn't running, thanks to user feedback!

In regards to bug fixes, there are a few we'd like to mention specifically. Mainly that the "Overflow" error some users were experiencing has now been resolved! We've also fixed some memory and GDI object leaks that were causing "Out of Memory" errors for certain computers, fixed level/experience from not being properly maintained in minimalistic saves and also fixed rounding issues with position of animations in sprite sequences (which resulted in certain movements not always being very smooth).

As always, you can see the full list of changes here: http://www.engine001.com/changes.htm

[h1]Tooltips are coming...[/h1]

Looking towards the future, I'm pleased to let you all know that we've begun the slow and arduous task of implementing tooltips for every major window inside 001 Game Creator. While the [b][url=http://www.engine001.com/wiki/]Online Wiki[/url][/b] will always provide the most detailed information about 001's features, we've nonetheless heard the outcry for built-in tooltips and have started doing exactly that! Once implemented, you'll be able to hover your cursor over any control in 001 to get a brief explanation of its functionality. This should help to clear up a lot of the confusion newcomers have with some of 001's more advanced features and we hope you look forward to seeing them!

We're planning to roll out the first batch very soon, which will include completed tooltips for the following main windows: Actor, Field, Sprites, Tile-Sets and Items/Magic.

[h1]NEW Video Tutorials are also on the way![/h1]

While on the subject of documentation, you'll also be pleased to hear that a brand new video tutorial series is currently in the works. After much deliberation, we've decided that the best approach would be to show a game being built from start to finish and showcase as much of 001's functionality along the way. We've already got someone on board who will be writing all of the tutorials and a framework is currently in the works that details what the series will end up covering. We hope to start rolling out video tutorials on a consistent basis once all of the details have been finalised.

[h1]001 Showcase![/h1]

Want to see the amazing things people have created with 001 Game Creator? Then why not follow the official [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/001gamecreator]001 Instagram[/url][/b] account for new posts every Monday, Thursday and Saturday to see exactly that! Here are some of the things you've been missing:

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/0d3387d1a563cd7734d37229b8bf1dafbe807bed.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/04b30f84d2aeb1eebb880fe8622f3c13f36db81c.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/8d4d6f455c823ca4418c7a8a3697096cdb781875.png[/img]

[h1]Until next time...[/h1]

Thank you all for your continued support of this project and to all of those who worked so hard on the creation of the [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/567360/001_Game_Creator__Point__Click_Adventure_Kit/]Point & Click Adventure Kit[/url][/b]. We hope you all enjoy this new content and are looking forward to what else we have in store in the future! :)

notes.title: NEW Features and a NEW Release!
notes.content:
With our [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/564681/001_Game_Creator__3D_FPS__Survival_Horror_Kit/]3D FPS / Survival Horror Kit[/url][/b] finally released, we're now back into the full swing of things! A new version of 001 Game Creator (v1.018.008) is now available on Steam and is packed with tons of new content and bug fixes.

As always, you can see the full change log [b][url=http://www.engine001.com/changes.htm]HERE[/url][/b] Now let's go over some of these changes, shall we?

[h1]Updated New / Open Game Window[/h1]

What better place to start than with the first thing you're greeted with upon opening 001 Game Creator. In an effort to make 001 a little more user-friendly, we've tweaked the New / Open Game window to be more streamlined:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/dccebce9c9d1820e5e7be86d32434a86f3ba3093.png[/img]

[h1]Updated Main Toolbar[/h1]

Additionally, we've cleaned up the main toolbar by removing the icons for Legacy Settings (now called Advanced Game Settings), Visual Settings and Startup Menu Settings. These options are still available in the main menu, as always, and are also now accessible in the Game Settings window too:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/9a37a1151ccba94ecbe86032c196e379d31517ab.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/ae530962d98a8854cf28d993a51e6122b7893c2e.png[/img]

[h1]Sprite Materials And Normal Maps[/h1]

Normal Mapping and Material Editing are now available for Sprites, having previously only been available for Tile-Sets, giving you access to custom shaders across the board!  They work the same way too! Simply select "Normal" from the "Mapping" drop down menu to add/edit your Sprite's normal maps. To edit materials, just click the "Edit Material" button next to the "Graphic Scripting" button to open the Material Editor:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/23777ffeff2ff3f55ad6d8ef05c85345853e13df.png[/img]

[h1]Walking Animation Scale[/h1]

This new Actor Graphic Option allows you to create fixed animation speeds, which is something that several users have been asking for. Essentially, this option allows you to specify the frame rate at which the Sprite animation plays at, regardless of its speed.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/5f14286876a76dc5b7f1ebccde913bfd34fbc57f.png[/img]

[h1]Performance Debugger[/h1]

We've updated 001's Debugger with a new "Performance" section that lists slow triggers and collisions. We hope this extra feedback will prove useful to those looking to optimise their games for the best possible performance!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/cb4d5ceddc8e6725c2c0efd894d260368032db2a.png[/img]

[h1]Improved Pathfinding[/h1]

Pathfinding (used by AI and for "Walk to..." type events) has been greatly improved, resulting in a lot of fixes to issues that have plagued users for some time, including characters teleporting into or getting stuck in nearby collisions.

[h1]Ignore Cursor Field Option[/h1]

And lastly, a small but very useful Field option that allows you to create overlaying Fields without them obstructing selectable Fields underneath them!

[h1]001 Games Showcase![/h1]

As we mentioned last time, we've created an official 001 Game Creator [b][url=https://www.instagram.com/001gamecreator/]Instagram[/url][/b] account where we've been sharing all of your 001 game creations! If you're on Instagram then please feel free to follow us for new posts every Monday, Thursday and Saturday! If you're got a 001 game you'd like us to showcase, then don't hesitate to get in contact with us!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/72b8630e9bf993c1ea601efdca037399d48e9c41.png[/img]

[h1]Oh, and one last thing![/h1]

We hope you enjoy the latest version and all that it has to offer. We're still working hard on our planned Point & Click Adventure Kit and so, with that said, here's a small parting gift from the team...a little sneak peek:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/3dd81c6985dfa155552507f8f853a74789ed711a.png[/img]

notes.title: 3D FPS / Survival Horror Kit RELEASED!
notes.content:
After a long wait, we're pleased to announce that our [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/564681/001_Game_Creator__3D_FPS__Escape_Room_Kit/]3D FPS / Survival Horror DLC Kit[/url][/b] has finally launched on Steam!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-MNdHHsKv3o
This DLC Kit provides users with a variety of 3D assets including 9 weapons (both firearms and melee), over 40 environmental objects, male and female arm rigs, 4 zombie enemies, 2 soldiers (male/female) with outfits and 2 room kits that include floors, walls, doors and trims.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9370680/cec2e6a9c719e2b21d0e3580b376adf8b223476c.jpg[/img]

notes.content:

notes.title: Online Multiplayer is FINALLY here - Update 9
notes.content:
Today I am pleased to announce a HUGE update for 001 Game Creator...You've read the title so you already know what it is: ONLINE MULTIPLAYER! With these powerful new networking tools you can create online multiplayer experiences ranging from 2-player cooperative play to full blown MMOs (providing you have the necessary skills to pull that off of course!) We've included two new demos to showcase this new functionality; a Tic-Tac-Toe demo and a 2D Fighting Game demo. These demos should help you to understand how to utilise these new features. Of course, our [url=http://www.engine001.com/wiki/networking]Online Wiki[/url] has also been updated with a full Online Multiplayer section to explain some of the essentials as well.

In addition, there is now a Steam build option and Steam API support (achievements, statistics, etc.) - along with a host of bug fixes.

We've also released a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/515880]Steam DEMO[/url] that allows users to try out the full set of 001 Game Creator features (including all of the new stuff mentioned in this update) for FREE for a limited time.

See the full change log for v1.017.004 here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/347400/discussions/0/481115363858417321/

And last but not least (if you hadn’t noticed already) we’re doing a week-long Steam sale, making this the perfect opportunity to grab a copy of 001 Game Creator whilst it’s 50% off! Sale ends on the 25th August 2016!

Thank you all for your continued support. We hope you enjoy this new update! :)

notes.content:
I'm pleased to announce that ownership of 001 Game Creator has been transferred back to SoftWeir Inc.

For those out of the loop, we've gone back to our original name "001 Game Creator". In addition, I'm also pleased to announce the Steam build has been updated to the latest version: v1.017.001

As always, you can view the full change log here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/347400/discussions/0/481115363858417321/

Aside from branding/logo changes back to "001 Game Creator", we've also fixed a number of reported bugs and added some exciting new features including: Sticky/Platform Physics, New Platformer AI and Ramp Tile-Sets for the Platformer Template...Basically, a lot of neat platformer stuff to really flush out that template. We hope these changes will encourage more users to create platform games!

We've also added support for multiple gamepads and completely overhauled the Input Trigger's Control Combination window to be far simpler and easier to use, with different input types being split into their own categories, instead of just one big list.

Lastly, [b]THANK YOU ALL[/b] for your support during this difficult transition! Your patience and understanding have been admirable and we couldn't have gotten through this without you and your support! :)

notes.title: Important Announcement
notes.content:
I must regretfully inform you all that Degica is no longer supporting GG Maker at this time. [b]This means that the Steam/RPG Maker Web versions will no longer receive any updates until further notice, and the new assets, DLC and video tutorials have been put on hold.[/b]

We’re doing our best to migrate everything back over to engine001.com where support will continue. The official 001 support email will still continue to function, as will our Facebook and Twitter pages. [b]The GG Maker email, forums and Steam forums will no longer receive support.[/b]

001 Subscribers will be unaffected and will continue to receive GG Maker updates so we'd like to encourage users to adopt a [b][url=http://engine001.com/subscribe.htm]Subscription[/url][/b] if you’d still like to use GG Maker and receive updates going forward.

We hope you’ll continue to support us through this difficult transition. Thank you.

notes.title: New Demos!
notes.content:
We've made a slight modification to the Steam build of GG Maker to allow it to properly sync the Demos/Examples when new versions are released.

Please make sure your Steam client downloads/installs the latest update we've just pushed. Upon starting the editor, you should see a small window pop up letting you know that it's updating the Demos/Examples and, once completed, you should then see the new 3D and Tower Defence demos in the "Demos" folder.

Big thanks to everyone who brought this problem to our attention! :)

notes.title: GG Maker Update 4
notes.content:
This is our first big update for the new year and comes packed with many new features that have been widely requested by the community! Things like [b]changing the camera zoom[/b], [b]date/time retrieval[/b] and [b]improved gamepad support[/b] (making it easier to set up analogue sticks, which used to be quite a chore) are now available in this latest release.

We've also updated the "Tower Defense" demo and added a brand new "3D Game" demo. You can learn more about what's coming up by reading this forum post: http://community.ggmaker.com/index.php?/topic/130-january-2016-news-updates/#comment-563

The full patch notes for v1.016.009 (and previous updates) can be found here: http://steamcommunity.com/app/347400/discussions/0/481115363858417321/

Thanks again for your continued patience and support! :)
